name: Aiko Tanaka
bio:
Aiko Tanaka's journey in motorsport began unconventionally. While her family expected her to follow a traditional path, her fascination with engineering led her to pursue mechanical engineering at Tokyo University. It was there, amidst the hum of engines in the university's racing club, that she discovered her true passion. Her meticulous approach and innovative ideas quickly caught the attention of Herberth Motorsport, who recruited her to their engineering team. 

Rising through the ranks, Aiko proved her mettle by consistently improving car performance and developing innovative solutions to complex technical challenges. Her ability to blend technical expertise with strong leadership skills eventually led to her appointment as Team Principal. Aiko's pragmatic approach focuses on data-driven decisions and fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. She emphasizes continuous improvement and is known for her ability to extract maximum performance from both her team and the machinery.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair with subtle layers and a side parting.
physical.description: Aiko has a focused gaze and a composed demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Prefers to conduct team meetings standing up to encourage efficiency.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deeply in thought.
